old_nic.label: Sri Lankan NIC (Old Format)
old_nic.description: 9 digits followed by V or X

new_nic.label: Sri Lankan NIC (New Format)
new_nic.description: 12 digit national identity number, validated against plausible birth-year/day-of-year encoding

payment_card.label: Payment Card Number
payment_card.description: 13-19 digit sequence validated with a Luhn checksum and a known card-network prefix

bank_account_context.label: Bank Account Number (contextual)
bank_account_context.description: 8-16 digit number appearing near an account-related keyword

iban.label: IBAN (International Bank Account Number)
iban.description: ISO 13616 IBAN structure, near an explicit IBAN label

telephone.label: Telephone Number
telephone.description: Sri Lankan local (0 + 9 digits) or international (+94 + 9 digits) telephone number

credential.label: Credential / Secret Assignment
credential.description: A password keyword directly followed by an assigned value

secureprint_token.label: SecurePrint Personal Access Token
secureprint_token.description: A SecurePrint personal access token (Windows agent credential) printed in a document

google_api_key.label: Google API Key
google_api_key.description: Google Cloud / Maps / Firebase API key

stripe_key.label: Stripe API Key
stripe_key.description: Stripe secret or publishable live/test key

jwt_token.label: JWT / Bearer Token
jwt_token.description: A JSON Web Token, optionally in an Authorization: Bearer header

generic_secret_assignment.label: Generic API Key / Secret Assignment
generic_secret_assignment.description: A generic API key/secret/token keyword directly followed by an assigned value

private_key_block.label: Private Key Block
private_key_block.description: A full PEM-encoded private key block

passport_lk_old.label: Sri Lankan Passport Number (legacy)
passport_lk_old.description: Legacy Sri Lankan passport format: N followed by 7 digits

passport_generic.label: Passport Number (contextual)
passport_generic.description: Generic alphanumeric passport number appearing near a passport label

employee_id.label: Employee Identifier
employee_id.description: Employee ID codes such as EMP-00123

salary_amount.label: Salary / Payroll Amount
salary_amount.description: Currency amount, used alongside salary keywords
